mapper.sql: a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_no AS accountNo, c.name AS customerName, a.amount AS cashAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED') THEN 1 END) AS holdingCount, MAX(CASE WHEN dsb.status IN ('TRADE_RESTRICTED', 'TRADE_SUSPENDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasRestrictedHolding
FROM account a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN domestic_stock_balance dsb ON dsb.account_id = a.account_id
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT a.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_id ) counted

SELECT dp.domestic_product_id AS domesticProductId, dp.ticker AS ticker, dp.name AS name, dp.sector_name AS sectorName, dp.type AS type, dp.domestic_stock_ratio AS domesticStockRatio, dp.inception_date AS inceptionDate, dsb.qty AS qty, dsb.status AS status, dsb.last_purchase_date AS lastPurchaseDate, dsb.avg_purchase_price AS avgPurchasePrice FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id WHERE dsb.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY dsb.last_purchase_date DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE status = 'OPENED') AS totalAccountCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dsb.account_id) FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dsb.account_id AND a.status = 'OPENED' WHERE dsb.status IN ('TRADE_RESTRICTED', 'TRADE_SUSPENDED')) AS restrictedAccountCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.amount), 0) FROM account a WHERE a.status = 'OPENED') AS totalCashAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(dsb.qty * dsb.avg_purchase_price), 0) FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dsb.account_id AND a.status = 'OPENED' WHERE dp.type = 'STOCK' AND dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED')) AS domesticStockAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(dsb.qty * dsb.avg_purchase_price), 0) FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dsb.account_id AND a.status = 'OPENED' WHERE dp.type = 'FUND' AND dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED')) AS domesticFundAmount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dsb.account_id) FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dsb.account_id AND a.status = 'OPENED' WHERE dp.type = 'STOCK' AND dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED')) AS stockHoldingAccountCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dsb.account_id) FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dsb.account_id AND a.status = 'OPENED' WHERE dp.type = 'FUND' AND dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED')) AS fundHoldingAccountCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dsb.account_id) FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dsb.account_id AND a.status = 'OPENED' WHERE dsb.last_purchase_date >= #{sinceDate} AND dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED')) AS recentBuyAccountCount

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, c.name AS customerName, a.account_no AS accountNo, dp.name AS productName, dp.ticker AS ticker, dp.domestic_stock_ratio AS domesticStockRatio, dp.inception_date AS inceptionDate FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dsb.account_id AND a.status = 'OPENED' JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE dp.type = 'FUND' AND dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED')

SELECT c.name AS customerName, a.account_no AS accountNo, dp.name AS productName, dp.ticker AS ticker, dsb.status AS status FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dsb.account_id AND a.status = 'OPENED' JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id WHERE dsb.status IN ('TRADE_RESTRICTED', 'TRADE_SUSPENDED') ORDER BY dsb.last_purchase_date DESC

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_no AS accountNo, c.name AS customerName, a.amount AS cashAmount, COALESCE(SUM(dsb.qty * dsb.avg_purchase_price), 0) AS investedAmount FROM account a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN domestic_stock_balance dsb ON dsb.account_id = a.account_id AND dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED') WHERE a.status = 'OPENED' GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_no, c.name, a.amount ORDER BY ${orderBy} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE status = 'OPENED'

select.if: SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_no AS accountNo, c.name AS customerName FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dsb.account_id AND a.status = 'OPENED' JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE dsb.last_purchase_date >= #{sinceDate} AND dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED')

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_no AS accountNo, c.name AS customerName FROM account a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE a.status = 'OPENED' AND a.account_id NOT IN ( SELECT dsb.account_id FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb WHERE dsb.last_purchase_date >= #{sinceDate} AND dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED') )
